cohort: 100 pregnant women (both primiparous and multiparous) at term pregnancy who underwent primary cesarean section for delivery at Mymensingh Medical College Hospital, Bangladesh, between December 2013 and May 2014
finding: The most common indication for primary cesarean section in this study was fetal distress (31%), followed by failed induction (13%), severe pre-eclampsia (7%), and eclampsia (4%).
